name: mirage
text: Fair question. They're big, but they're not sharp. Bovada is a large offshore recreational book. Veikkaus (Finland), Danske Spil (Denmark) and Mise-o-jeu (Quebec) are national or regional operators that mostly take casual bets. Their 6.8-9.2% hold is typical of soft books. Sharp books (Pinnacle and similar) run about 2-4%. That's why the sheet says no sharp book quoted this line and falls back to the market average. All four were added to the fair-odds list in October after a measurement (PropLine's lines for them sit within about 1.3 points of DraftKings/FanDuel, under 10% margin, quotes under 5 min old). So they're a reasonable average, not a sharp anchor. On this bet that's the weak spot: 4 books, all quotes 4-5 min old, all through PropLine, and fair +122 against Novig +127 is a thin 2.2% edge. Treat it as lower confidence. I haven't verified whether any of those four copy each other's lines. I can check that and tighten the rule (for example, require a sharp book or a fresher quote on college basketball). Want me to?
